name: I3DS
definition: An iterative framework for super-resolving NeRFs by alternating between 2D image upscaling via diffusion models and 3D NeRF synchronization to ensure view consistency.
summary: I3DS is an iterative framework that super-resolves low-resolution NeRFs by alternating between 2D diffusion upscaling and 3D synchronization, ensuring view consistency without high-resolution references.
